quarterly_data.signal: Record Q2 FY2026: record quarterly revenue (above $3B), gross margin 73%, operating margin 49% (record), record adjusted EPS ~$3+; sequential and YoY growth across all segments led by Industrial and Data Center; Q3 guide above-seasonal mid-to-high single digits on record bookings and positive book-to-bill

Communications/data-center revenue grew ~90%, fueled roughly equally by ADI power and optical portfolios (data center ~75% of comms); data center is the biggest mix driver and above corporate-average margin; strong AI-driven infrastructure investment in data center and ATE; positive multiyear secular outlook

Acquiring Empower Semiconductor for integrated voltage regulator (IVR) + silicon-capacitor IP — the 'final piece' of ADI's grid-to-core vertical power-delivery platform at the XPU/GPU/CPU: shrinks customer power footprint up to 4x, cuts data-center compute power consumption an estimated 10-15%, and delivers the ultrafast transient response volatile AI workloads need. 'The biggest bottleneck AI is creating for us today is power density and delivery efficiency.' Small revenue at close; design-ins in train with significant revenue expected 2027.
quarterly_data.figure: Empower acq: power footprint -4x, DC power consumption -10-15%; revenue surge 2027

Memory called out as a semiconductor supply-chain choke point (hitting consumer customers hardest). 2026 price increases (absorbing input inflation) add roughly 2 points to growth; Q3 comms guided fastest-growing, up low-to-mid-teens sequentially (data center = 75%+ of comms).
quarterly_data.figure: Internal capacity 2x; supports up to $20B; pricing +~2pts to 2026 growth
